project_name: Suvi Interior — Ultra Luxury Interior & Architectural Studio
context: Marketing Site / Luxury Atelier & Portfolio + Interactive Digital & Print Brochure

problem_analysis.user_feedback: User disliked Bodoni Moda on top (wordmark feels fragile/dated with generic wide tracking). Demands a far more luxurious, top 1% design benchmark, high-end editorial rhythm, phone-specific responsiveness, and a dedicated company brochure (/brochure) with print-to-PDF / A4 elegance.
problem_analysis.emotional_goal: Tactile quiet luxury, architectural gravitas, warmth of raw timber and milled stone, uncompromising craftsmanship, bespoke confidence.
anti_ai_rules_enforced: No Bodoni Moda, No Inter, No Roboto for headings
No center-everything disease: embrace asymmetric architectural margins and offsets
No generic 100% full-screen gradients; use tactile grain, crisp hairline borders, and museum-grade typography
No transparent dropdowns or ungrounded headers: glassmorphism with crisp 1px borders and saturate boost
Dedicated mobile floating contact bar and full-screen tactile drawer menu

typography.pairing_concept: The Architectural Atelier — Cormorant Garamond / Cabinet Grotesk / Plus Jakarta Sans

wordmark_treatment.font_family: Cormorant Garamond (or Cinzel for crisp Roman stone-carved alternative)
wordmark_treatment.style: font-serif text-[17px] sm:text-[19px] tracking-[0.28em] uppercase font-light text-charcoal
wordmark_treatment.wordmark_structure: SUVI INTERIOR — crafted with a thin golden dot or subtle vertical hairline divider between studio and city: 'SUVI INTERIOR' with sub-caption 'ATELIER & CRAFT • NASHIK'
wordmark_treatment.rationale: Cormorant Garamond possesses graceful proportions, bespoke high-contrast strokes and architectural warmth, solving the harshness and clunky feel of Bodoni Moda.

scale.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif font-light leading-[1.05] tracking-tight
scale.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-serif font-normal leading-[1.12] tracking-tight

colors.palette_name: Venetian Alabaster, Smoked Walnut & Aged Brass

header.style: Sticky/fixed nav with solid or crystal glass backdrop (bg-[#F8F6F0]/85 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-[rgba(37,33,29,0.08)]). Never transparent over dark areas without explicit scrim. Left: Wordmark 'SUVI INTERIOR' with tracking-[0.28em] in Cormorant Garamond. Center: Minimalist links ('Projects', 'Services', 'Studio', 'Brochure', 'Process'). Right: 'Download Brochure' or 'Consult Studio' button.

hero.style: Architectural split or full-bleed editorial canvas with warm wood/marble photography overlay max bg-black/40 (never darker). Large statement H1 'Crafting Quiet Magnificence for Living.' Subtitle with generous line-height. Direct CTA: 'Explore Portfolio' + 'View 2026 Studio Brochure'.

brochure_page.concept: A dual-mode luxury editorial publication: interactive digital magazine on web with flip/spread preview, plus high-res print stylesheet for A4 luxury brochure export/download.
sections: Brochure Cover Spread (Gold deboss aesthetic, Nashik Atelier, Established 2018)
Curator's Letter & Design Philosophy by Suvi Interior
Atelier Capabilities (Modular Kitchens, Italian Wardrobes, TV Architecture, Custom Solid Timber)

brochure_page.print_styles: Included in print stylesheet: page-break-after: always, hides header/footer/chat-floats, renders gorgeous full-page A4 editorial booklet layout.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Replace Bodoni Moda in public/index.html and tailwind.config.js with Cormorant Garamond (display) and Plus Jakarta Sans (sans).
2. Update the wordmark in Header.jsx, Footer.jsx, MobileMenu.jsx to use Cormorant Garamond with tracking-[0.28em] and refined luxury architectural proportions.

3. Build the new /brochure page (Digital Luxury Brochure with 6 distinct spreads: Cover, Philosophy, Services, Projects, Material Craftsmanship, Studio Contact) plus a print-optimized layout triggered by 'Download Brochure / Print' button.
4. Add the /brochure route to App.js and include 'Brochure' in nav and mobileNav arrays in site.js.
5. Implement a sticky mobile bar at the bottom for instant WhatsApp + Phone call + Brochure download with test ids.
6. Ensure all interactive and key informational elements have rigorous data-testid attributes.
7. Never use full transparent backgrounds behind sticky nav or dropdowns.
